opencv-python 4.10.0.84+nre5 - statement of changes (Apache License 2.0, section 4(b))

This wheel is built from the opencv-python 4.10.0.84 sdist from PyPI
(sha256 72d234e4582e9658ffea8e9cae5b63d488ad06994ef12d81dc303b17472f3526); OpenCV itself is
licensed under the Apache License 2.0 and opencv-python's packaging under the MIT license. The
upstream license files are retained. The files below were modified by NVIDIA CORPORATION &
AFFILIATES, 2026. This file is the statement of changes; the modified files themselves carry no
in-file notice.

Source changes (opencv-4.10-ffmpeg-8.patch):
- opencv/modules/videoio/src/cap_ffmpeg_impl.hpp: FFmpeg 8/9 compatibility. av_packet_side_data_get
  replaces av_stream_get_side_data; avcodec_close is skipped for libavcodec >= 62; the removed
  AVCodec supported_framerates array is read through avcodec_get_supported_config for
  libavcodec >= 63.
- opencv/modules/videoio/src/cap_ffmpeg_hw.hpp: the removed AVCodec pix_fmts array is read through
  avcodec_get_supported_config for libavcodec >= 63.
- cv2/version.py (opencv-python packaging, MIT): opencv_version stamped with the +nre5 local
  version at build time.

Build differences that are not source changes: the wheel is compiled against a shared LGPL
FFmpeg 9.0.1 bundled by auditwheel (the upstream PyPI wheel bundles FFmpeg 5.1.x).
